🐋 Sea life: Southern right whales (baleia-franca) come to the shallow bays of Santa Catarina's south coast every winter to calve, often within a few hundred metres of the beach. The stretch from Florianópolis south to Balneário Rincão is a federal protected area for them, and the season runs roughly June to November. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Southern_right_whale]
